note: All reflected EntityDataManager members are preserved. preferredForCoverage=true selects the richest successful member inside each case-insensitive duplicate group (highest parsed primitive-value count, then source size). This matters because lower-case backing/property accessors can contain both Sordland and Rizia while similarly named PascalCase accessors may contain only the current story pack.
